doc.title: Chico Hamilton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Staying in LA with Charlie Barnet; Gerry Mulligan hangs out
summary: Instead of Europe he joined Charlie Barnet's band on the strip, where he befriended the broke Gerry Mulligan.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: Yeah, here we traveled by train. I had my own compartment. It was first class all the way, first cabin all the way, which was cool. I guess later on, ‘55 or ‘54, or whenever that was, I decided I didn’t want to go back to Europe so I stayed in LA and I started working with Charlie Barnet’s band and every night we were on the strip somewhere.
